Withdraw on loss and publish allocation only after accepted ANNOUNCE. Bound pending work.

Advertise with the Milan schedule and valid_time 10. Advance available_index after an accepted advertisement. Initialization and departure reset the next advertisement index under [DEV-02](DEVIATIONS.md).
Handle global and own-entity discovery through the advertiser state machine. Ignore a foreign target. Preserve an already running delay.
Queue departure on shutdown from an active state. On link down, stop advertising and enter DOWN. Preserve shutdown departures across a restart.
Encode the supplied identity, capabilities, independent stream counts, Identify index and interface. Sample the current grandmaster and domain through the port.
Supply advertisement configuration consistent with the entity descriptors. Supply the current per-interface grandmaster and domain.

verification.reason: The library encodes caller data. It has no descriptor store or gPTP implementation.

text: Provide one stable EUI-64 entity identity derived from the selected interface MAC. Retain it across restarts and use it consistently in ADP and ACMP.

verification.reason: MAC derivation and restart stability are source product policy. IEEE permits MAC derivation; the core accepts a caller-supplied identifier.

text: Serve Milan listener bind, unbind and state commands. Serve talker probe and state commands with their status and flag rules.
Apply accepted connection and reservation state to the stream transport. Configure its VLAN, priority and any queue or shaper before enabling media.

verification.reason: This library owns no media queues or shaper. Their programming depends on the selected transport.

text: Restore saved bindings before opening transport. Admit restored talkers and resume discovery and probing without controller repair. Retain the binding during peer loss.
Persist complete binding records and started state. Validate and restore them before acmp_open. Roll back the entire restore if the store rejects the transaction.

verification.reason: The record codec and rollback are tested. Durable writes, power loss and boot ordering need an external store.

text: Allocate multicast destination ranges with PROBE and ANNOUNCE. Resolve conflicts and DEFEND the overlapping range. Withdraw validity when the range is lost.

clauses.text: IEEE 1722-2016 B.2, B.3 and B.4, Tables B.7 and B.8

text: Use stream destinations only while the MAAP range is valid. Withdraw affected destinations on allocation loss and publish current validity to the talker view.

verification.reason: The range callback reports allocation. The application assigns addresses to streams and owns media use.

text: Request reservation through env->srp after a successful probe. Withdraw it when settlement ends. Consume registration, withdrawal and kind changes through serialized feedback.
Connect the reservation callbacks to lwSRP. Maintain MSRP declarations and admission per stream and interface. Deliver ordered feedback outside callbacks.

verification.reason: MSRP and bandwidth admission are outside the three cores. The selected SRP component is lwSRP.

text: Register the stream VLAN through the external MVRP port. Keep each reservation and its VLAN associated with the correct interface.

verification.reason: ACMP exposes the VLAN in stream parameters. MVRP runs in lwSRP, outside this library.

text: Gate media transmission on actual reservation admission. Apply the reserved rate to any installed shaper. Withdraw permission when admission is lost.

verification.reason: Added beside the proposed SRP rows because reservation enforcement shares the datapath boundary. No shaper is supplied.

text: Assign each protocol instance one state owner. Serialize frames, timer expiry, link and grandmaster events through its port. Keep other protocol and transport ownership external.

verification.reason: Single ownership is portable. Placement switches and platform ingress hardware are excluded parts of the source row.

text: Budget at most 10 ms of total service per ADP, listener-discovery, ACMP or MAAP action. Include queueing, callbacks and refused sends. Account for only normative waiting time separately.

verification.reason: Ten milliseconds is project policy, proposed in the source register. Execution time depends on the scheduler and transport; no target timing is claimed.

text: Meet the Milan 200 ms ACMP transaction timeout with positive measured margin. Include ingress, service, egress and the network allowance.

verification.reason: Added because the source latency row also applies to ACMP. The core timer tests do not establish a wire deadline. AECP timing is excluded.

text: Recover core advertisement, discovery, probing and address allocation after delivered link, grandmaster and peer-loss events. Keep bound sinks eligible to reconnect without core reinitialization.
Detect and deliver link, grandmaster and peer-loss events. Count each event and its recovery outcome. Preserve service failures in diagnostics while recovery proceeds.

verification.reason: The cores expose selected counters, not a complete recovery event ledger. Media recovery and complete event counting belong to the application.

text: Build the same C11 core on Linux with GCC and Clang and as freestanding RV32I with the minimal port. Link all core objects without an OS dependency.

verification.reason: This is a build property. Hosted dependency audits and Debug and Release RV32 links inspect every core object.

text: Use caller-owned instances and fixed arrays sized before execution. Protocol code shall not allocate from the heap or call OS services.

verification.reason: Static arrays are the pools. Source and symbol audits check the cores on both targets; test framework allocation is outside the core contract.

text: Keep GoogleTest and GMock tests for the portable cores. Require 100% line and branch coverage after documented unreachable exclusions, and a caught named defect for each test.

verification.reason: Coverage and mutation run on Linux for the shared core source. RV32 runs the linked smoke suite. No RV32 coverage denominator is claimed.
